title: Ender Dragon Drops Elytra
description: Makes the Ender Dragon drop an Elytra on its first death in a world
body:
🐉 Elytra Dragon Drop

This lightweight mod makes the Ender Dragon drop an Elytra only on its first death in a world.

✅ Simple and balanced
✅ Elytra can be earned without raiding End Cities
✅ Works seamlessly with vanilla gameplay

When you slay the Ender Dragon for the very first time, it will drop one Elytra along with its usual loot.
Prevents multiple Elytra drops on subsequent dragon fights (only the first kill counts).

Perfect for survival worlds where you want earlier access to flight without breaking progression.
